seo.titleFull: Start Here — Health in Timor-Leste: the system, the data, and who is already working
seo.description: Start Here is an independent, sourced guide to health and the health system of Timor-Leste (East Timor): how primary health care and the national programmes actually work, what the data says and where it contradicts itself, links to the national clinical guidelines and essential medicines list, and a directory of the NGOs and partners already working in Timorese health. For clinicians, visiting teams and medical missions, NGOs, funders and researchers.
